provinces.lore: Tundra and hills around the snow-capped cone of Sương Diễm Sơn. No sect holds the mountain, and no one lives on its slopes. Fire and water cultivators both come here, each wary of the other.

provinces.name: Bích Thạch Lĩnh
provinces.lore: Mountains with a small volcanic heart where Noãn Ngọc Tuyền steams. Băng Tâm's disciples come to warm their meridians. Warm green stone is quarried here.

provinces.name: Tàn Tuyết Nguyên
provinces.lore: Tundra, hills and forest where snow lingers into summer. No one lives here since the city on its coast was abandoned in 655. Broken ice cliffs face the sea.

provinces.name: Ngân Ngư
provinces.lore: Forest and swamp on the north coast. Its people net silver ice-fish in winter and sell them in Mộc Lan. The ruin of the Gate of Ice and Fire lies inland.

provinces.name: Thán Diêu
provinces.lore: Inland forest far from the sea. Its people burn charcoal for the coast cities and the forges. Old Korean pines stand in the deep woods.

provinces.name: Bì Thuyền
provinces.lore: Forest around Vô Tung Lâm running to the sea. Its people build hide boats and hunt seals along the coast. A logging town swallowed by the forest lies inland.

provinces.name: Ám Sam Lĩnh
provinces.lore: Fir forest, bare hills and tundra on the west coast. No one lives here. Snow leopards hunt from its cliffs.

provinces.name: Lãnh Ngạn
provinces.lore: Forest on the west coast where sea fog rolls in. Its people gather mussels and seabird eggs from the cliffs. Fog-bound woods lie behind the village.

provinces.name: Tuyết Đăng
provinces.lore: Forest and swamp on the north-east coast around a timber town. Its people ship logs and furs down the coast. Wild plums bloom in the woods in late winter.

provinces.name: Vọng Phàm
provinces.lore: Forest, tundra and hills on the west coast. Its people fish and watch for sails from the cliffs. A town abandoned after Sương Diễm Sơn's week of fire lies on the coast.

provinces.name: Vô Thụ Nguyên
provinces.lore: Flat tundra on the north-east coast without a single tree. Reindeer herders cross it in summer. A Water vein lies in its centre.

provinces.name: Mộc Nhĩ
provinces.lore: Inland forest with low wet hollows. Its people gather wood-ear fungus and mushrooms and sell them dried. A Wood vein lies in the forest.

provinces.name: Triều Bình
provinces.lore: Forest on a sheltered east coast where the tide runs gently. Its people fish and farm a little barley. A silted-up harbour town lies on the shore.

provinces.name: Lư Ngư
provinces.lore: Forest on the east coast between Liên Giang and Tuyết Đăng. Its people fish for perch in the river mouths and sell them in Liên Giang. Cold green woods lie inland.

provinces.name: Tàng Sâm
provinces.lore: Deep inland forest between Mộc Lan and Liên Giang. Its people dig wild ginseng and sell it to Băng Tâm's alchemists. A Wood vein lies among old roots.

provinces.name: Thiết Chùy
provinces.lore: Forest and mountains on the south-west coast around Băng Lăng Khoáng. Its people mine and work the cold metal for Băng Tâm. A peak hung with icicles stands over the village.

provinces.name: Thanh Lăng Lĩnh
provinces.lore: Mountains and forest inland of the frost coast. No one lives here. Azurite is mined in summer.

provinces.name: Sơn Tra
provinces.lore: Inland forest on low hills. Its people gather hawthorn berries and make them into sweets and wine for Tống Khách market. Aspen woods grow on the slopes.

provinces.name: Ôn Khê
provinces.lore: Forest and mountains with a volcanic heart, where a river reaches the sea. Its people farm along a brook warmed by the fire below and sell early vegetables to Liên Giang. Rock junipers grow on the mountain.

provinces.name: Hoàng Dương
provinces.lore: Steppe, forest, mountains and red badlands along a river between the frost coast and the desert. Its people herd and hunt gazelle. An Earth vein lies on the steppe.

provinces.name: Ngân Sương Nguyên
provinces.lore: Tundra rising to bare hills and small glaciers, white with frost most of the year. No one lives here. A Water spring that grows frost flowers draws Băng Tâm's ice cultivators.

provinces.name: Phong Đao Lĩnh
provinces.lore: Bare hills and tundra on the north coast, where the wind cuts like a knife. Black jade is mined here in summer. No one lives here in winter.

provinces.name: Đống Trạch Hoang
provinces.lore: Tundra and frozen marsh with patches of forest on the north coast. No one lives here; yaks graze the plain in summer. Trappers cross it only when the marsh is frozen.

provinces.name: Hào Phong Lĩnh
provinces.lore: Bare hills and tundra around Tuyết Lang Nguyên, the snow wolves' plain. No one lives here. A Hàn Giang fort broken in the War of the Frost Coast stands on the coast.

provinces.name: Hàn Vụ Nguyên
provinces.lore: Tundra, forest and low hills often wrapped in cold fog from the sea. No one lives here. A mirror-clear Water vein lies on the plain.

provinces.name: Liệp Hộ
provinces.lore: Forest and swamp on the north coast. Its people trap sable and fox and sell the fur in Mộc Lan. A marsh school's ruin lies on the coast.

provinces.name: Kình Cốt
provinces.lore: Forest and swamp on the north-east coast. Its people hunt whales in summer with Trạc Anh's sea hunters and build with the bones. An abbey that joined Trạc Anh Đài lies empty on the marsh shore.
